Token decimals, set to 6 in the constructor.
SafeMath addition with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction with underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath division guarding against division by zero.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function writing _newOwner into newOwner state variable.
Second step of ownership transfer, requires msg.sender == newOwner and promotes newOwner to owner.
Token constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked arithmetic.
Constant view returning balances[tokenOwner].
Debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath.
Constant view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...) after the state update.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor.
transfer uses msg.sender to read and debit balances.
approve stores the allowance under the msg.sender key.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using caller identity.
approveAndCall writes allowance for msg.sender and forwards it externally.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument of receiveApproval.
acceptOwnership gates execution on require(msg.sender == newOwner).
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
owner is the recipient address used in the external ERC20 rescue transfer.
owner is compared with msg.sender inside onlyOwner for transferOwnership.
owner is emitted in OwnershipTransferred and overwritten with newOwner.
newOwner state variable receives the _newOwner parameter.
newOwner is verified and then promoted to owner, then reset to address(0).
The Aramco constructor assigns _totalSupply = 500000000000000.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply for its return expression.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the unsigned subtraction in totalSupply.
The constructor mints the whole supply by writing balances at a hard-coded address.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both parties.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend in the raw totalSupply subtraction.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
The constructor sets symbol = 'ARM'.
The constructor sets name = 'Aramco'.
The constructor sets decimals = 6.
totalSupply performs the raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without SafeMath.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract after the allowance state write.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an owner-supplied token address.
A malicious spender contract can re-enter transferFrom while already holding the granted allowance.
The external callee can re-enter approval/transfer entry points during the load-bearing external call.
The arbitrary token contract executes code while transferAnyERC20Token returns its result.
The spender parameter determines the external callee address of receiveApproval.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into receiveApproval.
The attacker-supplied data bytes are forwarded into receiveApproval.
The tokenAddress parameter determines the external callee of the rescue transfer.
The tokens parameter is passed to the external token transfer.
The _newOwner parameter is assigned to the newOwner state variable.
The to parameter is the credit key in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
The spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance amount in approve.
The from parameter is the balance/allowance source key in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credit key in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter keys the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
The spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a + b in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a + b in safeAdd.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a - b in safeSub.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a - b in safeSub.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a * b in safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a * b in safeMul.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a / b in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor of c = a / b in safeDiv.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter a only exists to feed the safeAdd addition and should collapse into the safeAdd function node.
Function parameter b only exists to feed the safeAdd addition and should collapse into the safeAdd function node.
Local return value c of safeAdd carries no independent semantics and merges into safeAdd.
Parameter a is a pure operand of the safeSub subtraction and merges into safeSub.
Parameter b is a pure operand of the safeSub subtraction and merges into safeSub.
Local return value c of safeSub merges into the safeSub function node.
Parameter a feeds only the safeMul multiplication and merges into safeMul.
Parameter b feeds only the safeMul multiplication and merges into safeMul.
Local return value c of safeMul merges into safeMul.
Parameter a feeds only the safeDiv division and merges into safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor used only by safeDiv and merges into safeDiv.
Local return value c of safeDiv merges into safeDiv.
The _newOwner parameter is written directly into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership and adds no separate semantics.
tokenOwner is only a mapping lookup key in balanceOf and collapses into that function node.
The named return value of balanceOf is not an independent entity and merges into balanceOf.
The to parameter is used only as the credit key inside transfer and merges into it.
The tokens parameter is the scalar moved by transfer and merges into transfer.
The constant true return of transfer carries no state and merges into transfer.
spender only keys the allowed mapping inside approve and merges into approve.
tokens is the allowance value written by approve and merges into approve.
The boolean return of approve has no independent meaning and merges into approve.
The from parameter is only the debit key of transferFrom and merges into that function.
The to parameter is only the credit key of transferFrom and merges into that function.
The tokens amount is consumed solely by transferFrom and merges into it.
The boolean return of transferFrom merges into the transferFrom function node.
tokenOwner is only the outer lookup key of allowance and merges into allowance.
spender is only the inner lookup key of allowance and merges into allowance.
The named return remaining is not an independent entity and merges into allowance.
spender both keys the allowance and names the external callee in approveAndCall, so it merges into that function.
tokens is the allowance and forwarded amount of approveAndCall and merges into it.
data is the forwarded calldata blob of approveAndCall and merges into that function.
The boolean return of approveAndCall merges into the approveAndCall function node.
tokenAddress only selects the external callee of transferAnyERC20Token and merges into it.
tokens is forwarded to the external transfer by transferAnyERC20Token and merges into it.
The forwarded boolean return of transferAnyERC20Token merges into that function node.
